purpose: Internal turnout source package inventory for Civic Result Maps. This file is not rendered in the app.
notes: Loaded packages are already represented in native ETL configs and promoted database turnout rows.
Missing requests identify the turnout denominator data needed before turnout-based screening can be enabled.
Do not use unofficial turnout data. Each new package must point to an official source artifact stored in this repository.
VerifiedVoting records are contextual election-equipment and audit provenance only; they must not be used as turnout denominators.

partialPackages.name: Wisconsin
partialPackages.authority: Wisconsin county and municipal election offices; Wisconsin Elections Commission ward results provide result/review rows but not turnout denominators

turnoutSource.sourceTitle: Wisconsin partial official local turnout package

denominatorSource.sourceTitle: Wisconsin partial local registered-voter denominator fields

caveats: This is not statewide Wisconsin turnout coverage.
Dane currently contributes one county-level row, not ward-level denominator rows.
Milwaukee and Oneida denominators are pre-Election-Day or explicitly dated before Election Day.
Wisconsin allows Election Day registration, so pre-Election-Day denominators can understate final registration and inflate apparent turnout rates.
